# CommandConfigWidget

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Editable menus and toolbars - one editor for a program's menus and its toolbars' groups, from one command catalogue ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget.md)); `ShowCommandConfigDialog` opens it in a window

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget> CreateCommandConfigWidget( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasCommandConfigWidget(const std::string& id);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetCatalogueFilter()` | `void SetCatalogueFilter(const std::string& toolbarName, std::function<bool(const MenuCommand&)> accepts)` | Which commands may go on the toolbar `toolbarName` (a palette takes tools only); every command when none is set. |
| `onApply` | `std::function<void(const CommandLayoutSet&)> onApply` | rebuild the live menus and toolbars now |
| `onSave` | `std::function<void(const CommandLayoutSet&)> onSave` | apply, and keep them |
| `onReset` | `std::function<void()> onReset` | the working copy is back to the baseline |
| `onCancel` | `std::function<void()> onCancel` | discard and close |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetRegistry` | `void SetRegistry(UltraCanvasCommandRegistry* registry)` | The catalog the commands come from; the process-wide Default() until set. It must outlive the widget. |
| `SetLayoutSet` | `void SetLayoutSet(const MenuLayoutSet& set)` | The menus to edit; also what Reset returns the menus to. |
| `AddToolbar` | `void AddToolbar(const ToolbarLayout& current, const ToolbarLayout& defaults, const std::string& title = "")` | A toolbar to edit, as it is now, and the program's defaults for it - what Reset returns it to, and what tells a group of the program's from one the user made. `title` is its name in the tree (default: the layout's name). |
| `ClearToolbars` | `void ClearToolbars()` |  |
| `AddSelectedCommand` | `void AddSelectedCommand()` | Add: the catalog's selected command after the selected entry - into the selected submenu or group, or a toolbar's last group. On a toolbar a command already in the group is shown again, not doubled. |
| `RemoveSelected` | `void RemoveSelected()` | Remove: a menu entry goes; on a toolbar a command of the program's group is hidden (it stays in its group, unchecked) and one the user added goes, a program's group is hidden and the user's own goes. |
| `AddGroup` | `void AddGroup()` | A submenu in a menu; a group of the user's on a toolbar, after the selected group. |
| `AddSeparator` | `void AddSeparator()` | A menu separator (toolbars separate their groups themselves). |
| `SetLayoutNodeChecked` | `bool SetLayoutNodeChecked(const std::string& nodeId, bool checked)` | The check box of a toolbar group (shown) or of a command in it. |
| `SetSelectedToolbarIconSize` | `void SetSelectedToolbarIconSize(ToolbarIconSize size)` | The selected toolbar's icon size and labels. |
| `SetSelectedToolbarShowLabels` | `void SetSelectedToolbarShowLabels(bool show)` |  |
